rationale: The assistant correctly read E:09 as a heating-circuit fault, pointed to the integrated circulation-pump/heater assembly as the leading suspect, and only moved to the resistance test with the appliance 'switched off at the socket and unplugged' and 'never with it plugged in'. The OL result was interpreted correctly ('commonly means replacing the circulation-pump/heater assembly rather than a small separate element') with sensible repair-vs-replace guidance for a 9-year-old machine and an engineer route for the fitting. Minor weaknesses: the first reply asked the customer to re-confirm a cold wash they had already described, the E:09 explanation was repeated verbatim, and it was slightly over-cautious in declining to identify the part when the model number was already known.
